smartTemplates.label: Repository: folder contents
smartTemplates.description: Children of a folder with mask and object type names (3-table join).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT o.objid, o.objshort AS name, m.maskname, s.name AS object_type, o.objtstamp
FROM objekte o
LEFT JOIN docmasks m ON m.maskno = o.objmask
LEFT JOIN sordtype s ON s.id = o.objtype
WHERE o.objparent = :parent_id AND o.deletedate = 0
ORDER BY o.objshort
LIMIT 200

smartTemplates.label: Search index values
smartTemplates.description: Full metadata search across all index fields — replace 'example' with your term.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT o.objid, o.objshort, k.okeyname AS field, k.okeydata AS value, m.maskname
FROM objkeys k
JOIN objekte o ON o.objid = k.parentid
LEFT JOIN docmasks m ON m.maskno = o.objmask
WHERE k.okeydata ILIKE '%example%'
LIMIT 100

smartTemplates.label: Objects per mask
smartTemplates.description: How many live objects are filed with each metadata mask.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT m.maskno, m.maskname, COUNT(o.objid) AS objects
FROM docmasks m
LEFT JOIN objekte o ON o.objmask = m.maskno AND o.deletedate = 0
GROUP BY m.maskno, m.maskname
ORDER BY objects DESC

smartTemplates.label: Document version history
smartTemplates.description: All file versions of one object with size and extension (objekte + dochistory + elodmdocs).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT o.objid, o.objshort, h.histversion, h.histcomment, d.ext, d.docsize, h.histid
FROM dochistory h
JOIN objekte o ON o.objid = h.objectid
JOIN elodmdocs d ON d.docid = h.documentid
WHERE h.objectid = :objid
ORDER BY h.histid DESC

smartTemplates.label: Largest documents
smartTemplates.description: Top 50 documents by file size with object name and mask (3-table join).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT o.objid, o.objshort, d.ext, d.docsize, ROUND(d.docsize / 1048576.0, 2) AS size_mb, m.maskname
FROM elodmdocs d
JOIN objekte o ON o.objdoc = d.docid
LEFT JOIN docmasks m ON m.maskno = o.objmask
ORDER BY d.docsize DESC
LIMIT 50

smartTemplates.label: Active workflow tasks
smartTemplates.description: Currently active workflow nodes with the archive object they run on (3-table join).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT w.wf_flowid, w.wf_flow_name, w.wf_nodeid, w.wf_name AS node_name, o.objid, o.objshort
FROM workflowactivedoc w
JOIN workflowhead h ON h.wfflowid = w.wf_flowid
LEFT JOIN objekte o ON o.objid = w.wf_eloobjid
WHERE w.wf_activate > 0 AND w.wf_terminate <= 0
ORDER BY w.wf_flowid DESC, w.wf_nodeid
LIMIT 200

smartTemplates.label: Workflow step trail
smartTemplates.description: Execution history (who did which node when) for one workflow instance.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT h.wfflowid, hist.wf_nodeid, hist.wf_username, hist.wf_activate, hist.wf_terminate
FROM workflowhistory hist
JOIN workflowhead h ON h.wfguid = hist.wfguid
WHERE h.wfflowid = :flow_id
ORDER BY hist.wf_activate

smartTemplates.label: Recent feed activity
smartTemplates.description: Latest feed posts with the archive object they belong to (3-table join).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT f.createdateiso, f.actiontype, f.actiontext, o.objid, o.objshort
FROM feedaction f
JOIN documentfeed df ON df.feedguid = f.feedguid
JOIN objekte o ON o.objguid = df.objguid
ORDER BY f.createdateiso DESC
LIMIT 100

smartTemplates.label: Hashtag usage
smartTemplates.description: How often each hashtag is used in feed posts.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT t.hstgname, COUNT(r.actionguid) AS uses
FROM hashtags t
LEFT JOIN hashtagrelations r ON r.hashtagguid = t.hstgguid
GROUP BY t.hstgname
ORDER BY uses DESC

smartTemplates.label: Audit: recent actions
smartTemplates.description: Latest entries of the audit log (report) with object names where still resolvable.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT r.reportid, r.acttime, r.actionno, r.userid, o.objshort, r.addtext
FROM report r
LEFT JOIN objekte o ON o.objid = r.docid
ORDER BY r.reportid DESC
LIMIT 200

smartTemplates.label: Object metadata changes
smartTemplates.description: Who changed which index values of one object (objekte + objhistory + objhistkeys).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT o.objid, o.objshort, h.objhistts AS changed_at, h.username, k.okeyname AS field, k.okeydata AS value
FROM objhistory h
JOIN objekte o ON o.objguid = h.objguid
JOIN objhistkeys k ON k.objhistguid = h.objhistguid
WHERE o.objid = :objid
ORDER BY h.objhistts DESC
LIMIT 300

smartTemplates.label: Soft-deleted objects
smartTemplates.description: Objects marked as deleted (deletedate <> 0) but not yet physically purged.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT o.objid, o.objshort, o.deletedate, o.deleteuser, m.maskname
FROM objekte o
LEFT JOIN docmasks m ON m.maskno = o.objmask
WHERE o.deletedate <> 0
ORDER BY o.deletedate DESC
LIMIT 200

smartTemplates.label: Customer aspect data
smartTemplates.description: Customer name/number aspect rows with their archive object and mask (3-table join).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT a.i_customer_number, a.i_customer_name, o.objid, o.objshort, m.maskname
FROM asp_3 a
JOIN objekte o ON o.objid = a.objid
LEFT JOIN docmasks m ON m.maskno = o.objmask
ORDER BY a.i_customer_number
LIMIT 200

smartTemplates.label: Mask field structure
smartTemplates.description: Index field definitions of one metadata mask.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT ml.mlineno, ml.linebez AS field_label, ml.linekey AS group_key, ml.linetype, ml.linemin, ml.linemax, ml.linedefault
FROM masklines ml
WHERE ml.maskno = :maskno
ORDER BY ml.mlineno

smartTemplates.label: Keyword lists
smartTemplates.description: All keyword list groups with their entries.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT g.swlgroupid, s.orderid, s.entry
FROM swlgrp g
JOIN swl s ON s.groupid = g.swlgroupid
ORDER BY g.swlgroupid, s.orderid
LIMIT 500

smartTemplates.label: PO lines by company
smartTemplates.description: Purchase order lines with vendor, company and currency names (4-table join, dictionary dropdown).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT pl.purchase_order_no, pl.line_no, pl.item_description, pl.quantity, pl.unit_price, pl.line_amount, COALESCE(fx.currency_symbol, pl.currency_code) AS currency, v.name AS vendor_name, co.name AS company_name
FROM sol_invoice_po_line pl
JOIN sol_vendor v ON v.company_code = pl.company_code AND v.no = pl.vendor_no
JOIN sol_company co ON co.code = pl.company_code
LEFT JOIN sol_common_fx fx ON fx.currency_code = pl.currency_code
WHERE pl.company_code = :company_code
ORDER BY pl.purchase_order_no, pl.line_no

smartTemplates.label: Vendor directory
smartTemplates.description: Vendors of one company with bank and tax data.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT v.no, v.name, v.street, v.zipcode, v.city, v.country_code, v.iban, v.vat_id, v.due_days
FROM sol_vendor v
WHERE v.company_code = :company_code
ORDER BY v.name

smartTemplates.label: FX rate history
smartTemplates.description: Exchange-rate history of one currency (newest first).
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT h.time, h.currency_code, h.currency_exchange_rate, h.base_currency_code, fx.currency_description
FROM sol_common_fx_history h
JOIN sol_common_fx fx ON fx.currency_code = h.currency_code
WHERE h.currency_code = :currency_code
ORDER BY h.time DESC
LIMIT 500

smartTemplates.label: Search Kundenakte
smartTemplates.description: Find customers by number, name or address — replace 'example' with your term.
smartTemplates.sql:
SELECT "Kundennr", "Kundenname", "Adresse", "Plz", "Ort"
FROM "Kundenakte"
WHERE "Kundennr" ILIKE '%example%'
   OR "Kundenname" ILIKE '%example%'
   OR "Adresse" ILIKE '%example%'
LIMIT 50
